summary: Comprehensive architecture and implementation plan for adding the dedicated Clothing Catalog and Product Showcase section to Vastra. Covers inventorying and processing all 8 uploaded catalog PDFs (Wedding, Sangeeth, Haldi, Engagement, House Warming, Baby Shower, Naming Ceremony, Pre-Wedding), extracting and organizing 50+ curated couture designs with professional names and unique product codes, building an editorial luxury catalog grid with search and multi-attribute filters, creating detailed product preview modals with bespoke WhatsApp/inquiry workflows, providing an interactive PDF library with view and download capabilities, and integrating a full administrator management dashboard with persistent local/in-memory data storage.
